## DPStyleARWebLive.stopCamera() method

Stop the camera module and release its resources. This method closes the camera pipeline and post-renderer resources, cleanly terminating the camera capture subsystem. The processing module remains unaffected.

**Signature:**

```typescript
stopCamera(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the camera module has been stopped.
